tasks.objective: Identify the exact affected .NET test projects through transitive literal ProjectReference links. All other literal ProjectReference edges are followed transitively regardless of declaration conditions.

stoppingRule: Run all six fixed pairs once, up to three verifier attempts per trial. Keep all observations and failed attempts. No favorable replacement or extra pairs. Threshold applies to final accepted completions; incomplete/failed final trials fail the threshold.
sharedConditions: One fresh agent per cohort, same inherited model/settings. Common runner starts clock at the first tool action before any file read; initial model dispatch/queue/first-response reasoning are excluded for both cohorts. All subsequent discovery, recommendation generation, writing, failed validation, correction and validation are included. All six fixed tasks run once each cohort; up to three verifier attempts per trial, no replacement of trials.
baseline: Inspect supplied manifests and derive the test set without using the new recommendation tool. Generic scripts allowed.
treatment: Use buildctl recommend-validation to derive the test set; generic scripts allowed.
launchOrder: Two waves of three pairs. Pairs 1,3,5 baseline first; 2,4,6 treatment first.
expectedSetProvenance: Independent XML graph traversal over captured project manifests; explicit IsTestProject false excluded and test SDK/true included. Oracle stored separately from solver fixture.
limits: Only the narrow planning task is measured. This is not feature implementation, test execution, or time to a passing PR.
